disclaimer: Illustrative hospital pilot planning model. Not a measured deployment timeline, legal approval, MDR classification, gematik confirmation or clinical authorization.
goal: Run a 30-day bounded CareOS pilot with up to 20 staff using read-only access, human review and no autonomous clinical decisions.
principles: nothing-to-do is a valid stakeholder state
real-data use starts only after the required organisational decisions
scope changes reopen only affected reviews

phases.label: Discovery
phases.goal: Choose one real workflow, name a sponsor and identify the first users.

blocking_tasks.action: Name the accountable pilot sponsor
Bound one concrete clinical workflow
Name the first 3–5 users

phases.label: Scope + Synthetic
phases.goal: Freeze intended use/non-goals and build safety evidence without patient data.

blocking_tasks.action: Freeze intended use and explicit non-goals
Define gold cases and critical-error taxonomy
Prepare MDR/AI/system-role pre-classification

phases.label: Parallel Reviews
phases.goal: Run independent organisational reviews in parallel where dependencies allow.

blocking_tasks.action: Resolve data scope and DPIA screening
Review identity, permissions, audit and rollback
Complete scoped regulatory memo
Classify KIS/FHIR/system role and allowed read-only path
Resolve DPA/AVV, subprocessors, licences and exit
Name incident owner, stop conditions and rollback runbook

non_blocking_but_early.action: Review workflow impact, training and feedback loop

phases.label: Readiness
phases.goal: Turn the remaining evidence into one bounded, scoped organisational pilot decision.
openaction: collapse open gates to real blockers

blocking_tasks.action: Decide the bounded shadow pilot scope, conditions, owners and rollback

phases.label: Shadow Mode
phases.goal: Use real data in parallel without letting CareOS affect care decisions yet.

blocking_tasks.action: Review about 50 real-data shadow cases against predefined thresholds
Run incident and rollback drill

phases.label: 5 Users
phases.goal: Run a tightly bounded first active pilot with 3–5 trained users and human review.
openaction: trigger Change Impact when assumptions change

blocking_tasks.action: Complete the first 5-user pilot
Review critical incidents, edit rate, source accuracy and workflow outcome

phases.label: 20 Users
phases.goal: Expand only after the 5-user evidence supports it and Change Impact identifies what must be rechecked.

blocking_tasks.action: Decide scoped expansion from 5 to 20 users
Scale onboarding, support and feedback
Monitor incidents, overrides and stop conditions

phases.label: Scale Decision
phases.goal: Use measured outcomes to stop, repeat the bounded pilot or prepare a larger production step.

blocking_tasks.action: Complete clinical outcome review
Verify real operation stayed within data assumptions
Decide stop, repeat or next scoped expansion

real_pilot_metrics: time to discover all required gates
time from complete review packet to decision
